from PIL import Image
import os

# ── LOGO: Crop right half \(dark-green version\) and remove dark-green background ──
logo = Image.open\('C:/Users/Ravi Desai/Downloads/graniry/graniry/logo_design.png'\).convert\('RGB'\)
w, h = logo.size

# Crop the right half \(dark green logo\)
right = logo.crop\(\(w // 2, 0, w, h\)\)
rw, rh = right.size

# Convert to RGBA for transparency
out_logo = right.convert\('RGBA'\)
pixels = out_logo.load\(\)

# Background color of the dark logo: ~\(13-19, 45-51, 27-32\) forest green
# Flood fill from all 4 corners with tolerance
def is_bg_dark\(px, tol=35\):
    r, g, b = px[0], px[1], px[2]
    return r < 60 and g < 80 and b < 60

# Replace flood-fill from corners
from collections import deque

def flood_remove\(img_data, w, h, start, check_fn\):
    visited = set\(\)
    q = deque\([start]\)
    while q:
        x, y = q.popleft\(\)
        if \(x, y\) in visited or x < 0 or x >= w or y < 0 or y >= h:
            continue
        visited.add\(\(x, y\)\)
        px = img_data[x, y]
        if check_fn\(px\):
            img_data[x, y] = \(0, 0, 0, 0\)
            q.extend\([\(x+1,y\),\(x-1,y\),\(x,y+1\),\(x,y-1\)]\)

flood_remove\(pixels, rw, rh, \(0, 0\),       is_bg_dark\)
flood_remove\(pixels, rw, rh, \(rw-1, 0\),    is_bg_dark\)
flood_remove\(pixels, rw, rh, \(0, rh-1\),    is_bg_dark\)
flood_remove\(pixels, rw, rh, \(rw-1, rh-1\), is_bg_dark\)

out_logo.save\('C:/Users/Ravi Desai/Downloads/graniry/graniry/store/public/logo-dark.png'\)
print\(f'Logo saved: {rw}x{rh}'\)

# ── PACKAGING LINEUP: Remove light gray/white background ──

def is_bg_light\(px, tol=28\):

    return r > 210 and g > 210 and b > 210

flood_remove\(ppx, pw, ph, \(0, 0\),       is_bg_light\)
flood_remove\(ppx, pw, ph, \(pw-1, 0\),    is_bg_light\)
flood_remove\(ppx, pw, ph, \(0, ph-1\),    is_bg_light\)
flood_remove\(ppx, pw, ph, \(pw-1, ph-1\), is_bg_light\)

out_pkg.save\('C:/Users/Ravi Desai/Downloads/graniry/graniry/store/public/packaging-lineup.png'\)

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = Image.open\("store/public/logo-dark.png"\).convert\("RGBA"\)
arr = np.array\(img\)

# Find bounding box of non-transparent pixels
alpha = arr[:, :, 3]
rows = np.any\(alpha > 10, axis=1\)
cols = np.any\(alpha > 10, axis=0\)
rmin, rmax = np.where\(rows\)[0][[0, -1]]
cmin, cmax = np.where\(cols\)[0][[0, -1]]

print\(f"Content area: rows {rmin}–{rmax}, cols {cmin}–{cmax}"\)
print\(f"Content size: {cmax-cmin+1}w × {rmax-rmin+1}h"\)

# Crop with small padding
pad = 20
rmin = max\(0, rmin - pad\)
rmax = min\(arr.shape[0]-1, rmax + pad\)
cmin = max\(0, cmin - pad\)
cmax = min\(arr.shape[1]-1, cmax + pad\)

cropped = arr[rmin:rmax+1, cmin:cmax+1]
out = Image.fromarray\(cropped\)
out.save\("store/public/logo-dark.png"\)
print\(f"Saved tightly cropped: {out.size[0]}w × {out.size[1]}h"\)
EOF)
